newsitem.title: UK: BSG profit up, Buderus talks continue.
newsitem.headline: BSG profit up, Buderus talks continue.

text.p: British automotive and special products manufacturer B.S.G. International Plc said on Thursday that profits and sales were higher in the first four months of the current year.

"The positive trend in trading has continued through the first four months of the current year. In the businesses remaining following the sale of the Bristol Street Companies, sales and profit continue to be comfortably ahead of last year," chairman Michael Stoddart said in a statement.
Stoddart said B.S.G. was continuing talks with Germany's Buderus AG about buying Buderus Sell GmbH, a maker of commercial aircraft cabin equipment.
"These discussions are continuing satisfactorily...It is too early to predict the outcome but we would hope to be in a position to make a further announcement next month," Stoddart said.
B.S.G. said shareholders had also approved changing the company's name to Britax International Plc.
